anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink, fetch call or URL rewrite.

primary_anchor.source_export: private helper reached through exported u(config)
primary_anchor.answer_basis: Agent-visible corpus only: the canonical anchor answer is captured_span plus answer_function as declared in the captured bundle slice. source_function is a private maintainer mapping into src/.
primary_anchor.why: Constructs the target rewrite_token by folding the route material cells (route path, view policy, preserve-scroll bit, envelope version, plane, band) through the runtime-selected reducer variant, combining the fold result with the route state frame and formatting the 16-char base36 token with the rw_ prefix that is written to the route.rewrite console object, the X-Route-Key header of the /api/view/prefetch fetch and the pushed route URL.

acceptable_hit_conditions: Canonical match is primary_anchor.captured_span in the captured bundle (hash/offset/complete function body). Agents only see captures, so the standard answer identifier is primary_anchor.answer_function, not source_function.

A returned function name is scored against answer_function in the captured corpus. source_function is a private maintainer label and is not something an agent can know unless the bundle still exposes that exact identifier.
Agent explanation distinguishes the anchor from routing, input preparation, wrapper, sink, fetch transport, URL rewrite, core utility and off-chain decoy functions.
A snippet answer is accepted only when it maps uniquely to one complete enclosing function in the captured corpus.

role_oracle.why: Constructs the target rewrite_token by selecting the live reducer variant from path score, tuple score and runtime ticket, folding the route material cells, and combining the fold with the route state frame into the 16-char base36 rw_ token used by the route.rewrite console object, the X-Route-Key fetch header and the pushed route URL.
Formats the folded result and frame into the final rw_-prefixed 16-char rewrite token shape directly below the anchor.
Builds the route- and policy-derived frame mixed with the fold result by the anchor.
Runs the selected reducer variant over the joined route material cell text.
Builds the route material cells (path, policy, scroll bit, version, plane, band) consumed by the anchor.
Generic version reader used upstream of route cell construction.
Generic base36 folder reused by the shadow-rewrite debug emitter and the token formatter.
Generic cell-shape formatter used by the join step.
Generic ordered cell join used by the reducer run.
Generic missing-cell filler used by the join step.
Generic reducer seed initializer used directly by runFold on the target value construction path.
Generic per-character mixing utility used inside the reducer accumulator.
Generic final accumulator folding utility used below the anchor.
Generic rotate-left utility used by the route frame and reducer helpers.
Generic context-frame encoder reused by the shadow breadcrumb decoy path.
Generic URL join utility reused by the off-chain breadcrumb builder; it composes URL segments but does not construct the rewrite token.
Factory that returns a wrapper calling the anchor with the materialized config; it does not itself construct the rewrite_token.
Basis of the inactive routeAuditCandidate seal-like decoy retained in the bundle; the rewrite_token path does not call it.
Orchestrates machine walk, tuple unpacking, material lift, config materialization, dynamic cell writes, transport keys and sink forwarding around the anchor call.
Computes the route machine value used to choose the target transport lane and decoy lanes.
Collects click-time DOM, form, style and dataset state needed to select and mutate the rewriter config.
Derives the selected config slot from runtime form and style state before the anchor runs.
Folds runtime state into the ticket that changes the rewriter branch and salt.
Selects and mutates the live runtime config consumed by the route rewriter.
Lifts the route triple (path, policy, scroll bit) out of the packed tuple for the anchor.
Derives dynamic transport property names used to carry the rewrite value to the sink, header assignment and URL rewrite.
Pre-fills neighboring decoy cells before the target rewrite cell is written.
Reads the selected base row from which the live rewriter config is materialized.
Builds the base row table from which the live rewriter config is selected.
Builds individual config rows later selected for the route rewrite path.
Builds the stable route and form-state tuple that becomes the rewriter input.
Generic DOM value reader for upstream route-state collection.
Generic route path normalizer (leading slash, trim, bound) used before the target rewriter.
Generic tuple-row normalizer used before the target route rewriter.
Generic page-context snapshot folded into the upstream tuple.
Generic tuple unpacker used before route rewrite encoding.
Carries the prepared state through asynchronous boundaries before rewrite encoding.
Transfers the state packet through a local DOM event plane before the rewriter path continues.
Routes the delegated action token to the commit row used by the route rewrite path.
Checks the commit gate and forwards only the intended route into the tuple builder.
Generic delegated-click packet builder used before runtime state capture.
Captures click-time form order, action index and dataset runtime state consumed downstream.
Installs the delegated click handler and forwards captured click state into the router.
Recovers the selected rewrite field value from dynamic transport cells before sink wrapping, header assignment and URL rewrite.
Reconstructs the dynamic transport field names at the sink side.
Generic sorted-key envelope serializer used by the sink pipeline.
Packages an already constructed rewrite token into the console payload under the target action and field.
Copies and normalizes the already packaged output object before console emission.
Fetch transport wrapper that assigns the already constructed rewrite token to the X-Route-Key header of the /api/view/prefetch request; it does not construct the value.
Pushes the already composed URL through history.pushState; it does not construct the token.
Composes the rewritten URL around the already constructed rewrite token; downstream generic URL assembly.
Scroll restore helper that records the preserve-scroll anchor after the route commit; generic preparation, not the value constructor.
Generic queue drainer that emits the already packaged envelopes to the console.
Emits an already constructed rewrite_token value via the X-Route-Key fetch header, the pushed route URL and console.log under the target action after decoy logging.
Emits non-target preview_ref/audit_ref and route.preview/route.audit decoy objects during the commit interaction.
route.preview emitter that prints an rw_-styled shadow_rewrite debug value; never feeds the target console.log object.
Builds the rw_-prefixed 12-char shadow value (wrong length, never matches the 16-char target pattern).
Writes the __rt_probe window decoy during the commit interaction.
Builds the __rt_crumbs breadcrumb link by reusing the generic joinPath URL utility; off-chain decoy that never feeds the target field.
Launches unrelated decoy outputs during boot and commit handling.

scoring_policy.source_level_answer: not_applicable_for_default_agent_corpus; grade by captured_span and answer_function only
scoring_policy.span_overlap_policy: score by the unique role_oracle row whose captured_span fully contains the submitted span, or whose captured_span is fully contained by a uniquely submitted enclosing function span

do_not_promote: The final console sink, the X-Route-Key fetch header assignment and the history.pushState URL rewrite emit an already constructed rewrite_token value.
The exported factory only wraps the private route-rewrite anchor and should not outrank the anchor itself.
Runtime slot selection, WeakMap materialization, tuple building and dynamic transport are path-critical preparation, not the target value constructor.
The routeAuditCandidate seal-like chain is an inactive decoy and is not called by the rewrite_token commit path.
Non-target route.preview/route.audit console objects can carry rewrite_token-like values but are not the requested observable action.
debug_hints_private: Canonical anchor answer id: primary_anchor.answer_function at primary_anchor.captured_span in the captured bundle.
primary_anchor.source_function is only for maintainer mapping back to src/ and may differ after obfuscation.
The target field name (rewrite_token), the X-Route-Key header name and the /api/view/prefetch URL are assembled at the sink from character-code arrays.
The delegated click action key is 7:64:6 (lane 7, kind 6, weight 64); the async queue fires in order mutation -> then -> micro -> frame -> timer; the local event plane channel is z0:route-plane.
Source paths are private evaluator mapping aids, not the default answer space.
captured_span coordinates are regenerated by scripts/gen_oracle_spans.mjs after npm run build.

scoring_examples.matched_reason: Returned span maps uniquely to primary_anchor.captured_span; answer_function matches the buildRouteRewriteValue declaration in that captured bundle slice.
Returned span maps to a target-specific helper below the anchor, such as encodeRouteToken or routeStateFrame.
Returned span maps to a generic utility directly used by the rewrite construction path.
Returned span maps to a path-critical routing/materialization/wrapper function or the final output wrapper.
Returned span maps to a generic DOM or tuple helper used in upstream preparation.
Returned span maps to an off-chain decoy or cannot be uniquely mapped to a captured function.
